Summary of the current run, from the monitoring assistant that watched the instruments:

The temperature is stable at 750.0 degrees Celsius. Heater power has stabilized around 46% after the ramp phase. Argon flow remains steady at approximately 100 sccm. Chamber pressure shows a slight upward trend, currently at 3.329 Torr. Note that the exhaust oxygen sensor is not installed.
